$comment: Demo patients (ADR-0009). Each persona exercises one path through the clinic's flowchart; glucose readings and insulin regimen come from one real, de-identified recording in ShanghaiT1DM/T2DM (CC BY 4.0). Names, clinic history, and profile flags are fictional. Stories were adjusted to fit the data (QST-SYNTH-SCENARIOS: B). Build: patients/build.py; load: patients/load.ts.

dataset.name: ShanghaiT1DM and ShanghaiT2DM
dataset.citation: Zhao Q, Zhu J, Shen X, et al. Chinese diabetes datasets for data-driven machine learning. Scientific Data 10, 35 (2023).
dataset.changes: Timestamps re-anchored so the last reading falls at load time; window trimmed to end shortly after the scenario's key event (at most 14 days); regimen summarized from the subject's dose records; name, clinic history, and profile flags are fictional.

personas.path: quick advice (no red flag, no high-touch criterion)
personas.story: Type 2 on long-acting insulin; steady readings.

personas.path: RED FLAG glucose > 350, plus HIGH-TOUCH new steroid start
personas.story: Type 2 on premixed insulin; many readings above 350. The steroid start is fictional (no steroids appear in the dataset).

special_plan.$comment: ADR-0019: a provider's dated plan, invented for testing; build.py copies it into regimen.special_plan. started_days_ago matches clinic_history.days_since_steroid_start.
special_plan.title: Prednisone taper

steps.insulin: Insulin aspart 70/30: 18 units before breakfast, 12 units before dinner
Insulin aspart 70/30: 16 units before breakfast, 12 units before dinner
Insulin aspart 70/30: 14 units before breakfast, 12 units before dinner
Insulin aspart 70/30: 12 units before breakfast, 12 units before dinner (the usual plan)

special_plan.after: After day 14, prednisone ends and insulin goes back to the usual plan.
special_plan.check: While on prednisone, sugar checks before meals and at bedtime. The plan says to call the clinic if sugar is below 70, or above 300 twice in a row.
special_plan.demo_note: Made up for testing (ADR-0019). Not clinical guidance.

personas.path: RED FLAG history of DKA with high glucose; pump failure via the conversation; HIGH-TOUCH new pump start
personas.story: Type 1 with a recorded history of diabetic ketoacidosis; insulin pump readings. In the dataset the pump insulin was given in hospital, so the home-pump framing is part of the demo story.

personas.path: RED FLAG severe low / more than 2 lows in 48 hours
personas.story: Type 2 on long-acting and mealtime insulin; several lows within 48 hours, at least one severe (below 54). Recording changed from 2069_2 (85) because its lows and its severe low did not fall in the same 48 hours.
Type 2 on long-acting insulin and metformin; pregnant (fictional flag). Changed from type 1 because the dataset has no young woman with type 1.

personas.path: HIGH-TOUCH from history only (last visit > 6 months, > 4 calls in 2 months)
personas.story: Type 2, 84, on premixed insulin; steady readings. Only the clinic history makes him high-touch.
